title: A fix after a passed fix check is recordable without a new chain or an owner grant
why: After #2992's fix check passed (8c837aa36), batch 115 found a 6-line test-only defect (fix f30500427, red then green). `merge --review-record --fix-check` refuses a second fix check, so the lane needs an owner round-4 grant or a fresh full chain.
source: lane ruled-store-one-home 21:20 CST and coordinator 21:21 CST Nov 12
note: Owner pick a on item fix-check-chain-cap (10:19 CST Nov 8): "a chain may hold two fix checks, then a fresh chain". Decision pr-review-record on main says "One fix verifier per record" (exception: a conflicted main merge after a PASS). Possible stale decision: the decision does not carry the Nov 8 pick, or a later ruling narrowed it. Lane reads the history first (rule outcomes-stale-decision-protocol), then either aligns the merge tool with the pick (red then green) or brings the gap. Meanwhile: owner item 675 grant-round4-2992. Retrospective 21:38 CST Nov 12, Degen ledger D25: a third restart at round 1 (605 to 667) after 597 to 635 to 656. No owner item (triage 21:44 CST): decision pr-review-record already rules it (owner 2026-11-10 14:07 CST, lines 18, 76, 125, 129): a conflicted merge of main after a PASS fix verifier takes one more fix verifier when it edits only its conflicted paths; it replaced the Nov 8 chain cap. So the retrospective's option a is on main, except "or the tests it broke". Open: measure why Degen's three restarts missed that route (edits outside conflicted paths, or a stale merge tool) and fix that cause.
